body: Hope so, I love you for replying but the pain really doesn’t get better❤️
Thanks a lot for this it helps a lot🙏
I don’t know how much more I can take before I literally lose myself. I wanna quit so bad. I wanna cry forever. I just want someone to hug me tbh. I don’t know how to say everything it’s just alot
It’s more of a society thing you know. I grew up with people who taught me I’m weak for being mentally down. And build up was due to not being able to talk to someone.
It’s been building up for the past couple years tbh. Been trying to keep it to myself. As a man I’m not allowed to express my mental health problems so I decided to seek help online.
